facts.activity_file: testing earth leakage and protection settings

control_failures.control_label: proving zero energy before intrusive work

facts.title: residual pressure found after isolation of G-8101

response.consequence: The recorded outcome was no injury or loss. The potential outcome was rated 2 against the site's consequence scale, above the 0 actually realised.

defences.finding: Control ZERO_ENERGY_VERIFICATION: the proving zero energy before intrusive work was not in place, and the accident investigation classified this as a task or environmental condition.

recommendations: Confirm at the next spot check that the proving zero energy before intrusive work on G-8101 and G-8103 performs as designed.
response.sequence: Work was under way in maintaining protective systems, specifically testing earth leakage and protection settings. G-8101 (gas turbine generators) is in service for on-site generation. The task proceeded during transfer operations while the proving zero energy before intrusive work was not in place. The thermal energy involved is held as hot surface, and the recorded presentation was burn, ignition, scald.
response.summary: On 25 August 2009 a near hit was recorded on G-8101 and G-8103 at Tolgarra Processing and Power Station during transfer operations; thermal energy held as hot surface was not released.
